title: fumana ericoides subsp. montana
intro: Fumana ericoides subsp. montana, commonly known as the Alpine rockrose, is a plant species within the Cistaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fumana ericoides subsp. montana are attributed to its ability to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
